name: Indenture
source: The Nishimura family resides in the quiet countryside far away from the city in Japan. A proud family with a history of Kendo and owns a Kendo Dojo, their name was famous and influential. That is of course until one day, tragedy struck their family. A haunting secret deal that was made by the family years ago has come to haunt them. How would the Nishimura family deal with this? Would it be the end of them or is there a way to save their reputation and their beloved Dojo?
translation: 西村一家住在远离城市的日本宁静乡间。这是一个以剑道为傲的家族，拥有一间剑道道场，家族名望显赫、颇具影响力。然而有一天，一场悲剧降临在这个家族身上。多年前家族做过的一笔秘密交易，如今成为纠缠他们的梦魇。西村一家将如何应对？他们会就此败落，还是能挽回名誉，保住心爱的道场？
